notes: New Smart search (Settings, Smart search). Turn it on and you can find a Keep by what it means, not only its words. It uses your own free Gemini key and is off until you switch it on.
The Keep text is sent to Gemini once to work out its meaning. Pictures and files are never sent. The results stay on your phone and you can delete them any time.
Related Keeps now match by meaning. Suggested Spaces can group your Keeps by meaning and give each group a name and a reason. You still approve every Space.
Search shows normal results straight away, then adds the ones found by meaning.
